text:
kim: Ok team — originating RC from commit `a7f3d2b` (docker: rgw/service:1.22.0-rc1). Change window 2026-03-21 16:00-18:00 PT. Need QA smoke + infra signoff by 16:30 PT, then pin and promote if green. Can we start checks?

deploy-bot: [CI] candidate build 1.22.0-rc1 queued, artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-artifacts/rcs/a7f3d2b. /status for checks.

alex: grabbing a quick run of the integration suite now. any DB migration flags? I see `migrations/2026_03_add_index.sql` included.

priya: release notes draft is updated: https://docs.internal.redwood/releases/1.22.0-rc1.md — added migration note and downgrade caveat. please review bullets.

sam: canary plan? prefer 2% -> 10% -> 50% over 20m steps. Also verify KV cache warming before prod shift.

maria: QA smoke started on candidate (env: rc-smoke). tests: login, embeddings, chatflow, billing. so far login + chatflow pass, embeddings flaky on long context (investigating).

oncall_jordan: Heads up — rollback playbook updated for this RC (rollback latch: immediate artifact pin to previous tag `1.21.8` + traffic shift script `traffic_toggle --to previous`). Deadman switch set at 15m post-promo. I will be on standby during promotion.

ops: We have capacity in east1 and west2 for burst. If canary latency > 250ms, autoscale policy will add more workers; be ready for cache preload.

alex: integration suite done — all green except the DB index migration check warns about holding locks on large tables. We should run the migration in a rolling mode with `--no-lock` option, or schedule after lower traffic.

kim: Good catch. Let's change plan: pin RC but hold DB migration to 22:30 PT out-of-window, and include migration as post-promote maintenance with read-only for 10m. Agree?

maria: QA smoke retest after disabling long-context embedding test — quick checks green now. embedding regression ticket opened: INT-4567.

priya: release notes updated to reflect embedding regression and migration scheduling. Added rollback steps and SLO watch links.

deploy-bot: /status checks: build: success, smoke: success, infra-health: green, canary-plan validation: OK. Ready for pin.

kim: Requesting approvers: @alex, @priya, @maria, @oncall_jordan — please respond with :+1: to pin and promote (without DB migration).

alex: :+1: for pin/promo without migration. DB migration held.

priya: :+1: release notes approved.

oncall_jordan: :+1: oncall ready, deadman switch armed.

kim: Pinning RC to candidate slot now and creating rollout. deploy-bot, please pin artifact `a7f3d2b` to `rc-stable` and schedule canary per sam's plan.

deploy-bot: Action: pinned artifact a7f3d2b -> rc-stable. Canary rollout scheduled: 2% @16:40 PT, 10% @17:00 PT, 50% @17:20 PT. Post-rollout health check 15m.

ops: noted — pre-warming caches in east1 starting at 16:30 PT.

kim: Triggering promote now. Will monitor dashboards; call out if any >2x error rate or latency regression.

deploy-bot: Promote started. Promotion ID: promo-3629012345-1. Canary stage 1 (2%) in flight.

maria: smoke on canary instances looks good so far. no errors in 10m window.

sam: KV warmup completed, initial latency within expected band.

oncall_jordan: Observability check: SLOs nominal. setting alert sensitivity to high for next 30m.

deploy-bot: Canary stage 1 complete. Metrics: error_rate +0.1%, p95 latency +10ms. Promoting to 10%.

alex: running quick regression query set against the canary fleet — all passing.

deploy-bot: Canary stage 2 complete. Metrics stable. Promoting to 50%.

ops: scaling healthy, no capacity issues.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. All traffic at target. Post-promo health check in progress.

maria: post-promo sanity: login, chatflow, billing smoke all green. embedding regression still isolated to longer contexts (tracking INT-4567).

oncall_jordan: Deadman switch still available; no action needed. Will keep monitoring until window close.

kim: Thanks everyone — RC promoted to prod. Filing release note publish and tagging commit in changelog. If anything pops up, call in #incidents.

deploy-bot: Release published to changelog, tag `1.22.0-rc1` created. CI: artifacts archived.

kim: Closing thread — next steps: schedule DB migration out-of-window, follow up on embedding regressions in next sprint. :tada:
